title: Breakfast at the Cafe
story_text: Last summer, Lily took a job in a small cafe. She worked from eight a.m. to two p.m. every day. She was a waitress, so she carried food to the tables. Her aunt said, "Never be late for duty." One morning Lily got up late and ran all the way. She was angry with herself. She put the chips and a snack on the table, then smiled at every guest. Nobody knew she was tired. At two p.m. she went home and slept. Now she is never late for duty again.
translation_zh: 去年夏天，莉莉在一家小咖啡馆找了份工作。她每天从上午八点工作到下午两点。她是女服务员，所以要把食物端到桌上。她姑姑说：「值班绝不能迟到。」一天早上莉莉起晚了，一路跑着过去。她很生自己的气。她把炸土豆条和一份小吃放到桌上，然后对每位客人都微笑。没人知道她很累。下午两点她回家睡了觉。现在她值班再也不迟到了。

title: The Harvest Feast
story_text: In October, Ben's village had a big carnival. There was music and dancing in the square. His uncle looked after the cattle on the farm, so there was fresh milk for everyone. Ben's family cooked for the harvest feast, and everyone helped. His mother made a roast turkey with cheese inside. His father cooked a pumpkin soup and a spicy pudding. On the table there was also bread, butter and a little wine for the grown-ups. Ben ate too much and could not move. Then his little sister said, "Let's dance!" So he danced. At the end of the night, everyone went home happy and full.
translation_zh: 十月里，本的村子举办了一场盛大的狂欢节。广场上有音乐和舞蹈。他叔叔在农场里照看牛，所以每个人都有新鲜的牛奶。本一家为丰收节的盛宴做饭，大家都来帮忙。他妈妈做了一只里面塞了奶酪的烤火鸡。他爸爸煮了南瓜汤和一份辛辣的布丁。桌上还有面包、黄油，以及给大人们准备的一点葡萄酒。本吃得太撑，动都动不了。这时他妹妹说：「我们去跳舞吧！」于是他就去跳了。那天夜里结束的时候，每个人都又开心又满足地回了家。

title: A New Start for Tom
story_text: Tom was not happy with his body, so he began to think about his fitness. He ate chips every day and never played sports, so he felt tired all the time. One Monday he decided to change. He started a simple diet: more vegetables and fruit, less sugar. For breakfast he ate bread with butter and honey. For dinner his mother cooked rice with mushrooms. Every evening he ran in the park for twenty minutes. After four months, Tom was slim and full of energy. His friends asked him for his secret. He smiled and said, "Just start, and do not stop."
translation_zh: 汤姆对自己的身材不满意，于是开始关注自己的健康。他每天吃炸土豆条，从不做运动，所以总是觉得很累。某个周一，他决定改变。他开始了一种简单的规定饮食：多吃蔬菜和水果，少吃糖。早餐他吃涂了黄油和蜂蜜的面包。晚餐他妈妈做蘑菇米饭。每天傍晚他在公园跑二十分钟。四个月后，汤姆变得苗条又充满活力。朋友们问他秘诀。他笑着说：「只要开始，就别停下。」

title: Anna's Small Start
story_text: Anna was outgoing and friendly. She wanted to learn English well, so she bought a small notebook and wrote down one new word every night. Her teacher said, "That is a worthwhile habit." Anna liked to quote her grandmother: "A little every day is better than a lot once." With this measure, she made progress step by step. She also helped an ongoing class project about food in different countries. She learned to measure sugar for a simple cake. In the summer, she joined a carnival in her town and talked to foreign visitors. She was afraid, but she did not stop. Now she can speak to anyone.
translation_zh: 安娜性格外向又友好。她想把英语学好，于是买了一个小本子，每晚记下一个新词。她的老师说：「这是个值得做的习惯。」安娜喜欢引用她奶奶的话：「每天一点点，胜过一次做很多。」用这个方法，她一步步取得了进步。她还帮忙做一个持续进行的课堂项目，主题是不同国家的食物。她学会了为一块简单的蛋糕量取糖的用量。那年夏天，她参加了镇上的狂欢节，还和外国游客说话。她很害怕，但她没有停下。现在她能跟任何人交谈了。

title: A Surprise for Mum and Dad
story_text: Ben wanted to cook a special dinner for his parents. Every Saturday he was on duty in the kitchen, so he already knew the work. On the big day he got up at six a.m. and started. He put cheese and tomatoes into a big pot. When the food was cooking, he ate a small snack because he was hungry. At seven a.m. his parents came home. They saw the table, the food and the candles. It looked like a small carnival in the kitchen. His mother laughed and said, "This is the best dinner of the year."
translation_zh: 本想为爸爸妈妈做一顿特别的晚餐。每个周六他都在厨房值班，所以他已经熟悉这份活儿了。大日子那天他早上六点就起床开始动手。他把奶酪和西红柿放进一口大锅。菜在煮的时候，他吃了一小份点心，因为他饿了。上午七点，他父母回到家。他们看到了餐桌、饭菜和蜡烛。厨房里看起来就像一个小小的狂欢节。他妈妈笑着说：「这是今年最好的一顿晚餐。」

title: The Awkward Question
story_text:
Mia was new on the school newspaper. Her first job was to talk to Mr. Bell, an old man who worked in the school garden. Before she started, she felt anxious.

"Why is your garden dead?" she asked.

The question was rude. Mr. Bell said nothing. The silence was awkward, and Mia's face turned red. It was an embarrassing minute for her.

But Mr. Bell only smiled. "I pulled out all my plants," he said. "I am curious about what will come up next."

Mia wrote a brief note and went home. She put the note in her book.
translation_zh:
米娅是校报的新成员。她的第一项任务是去采访在学校花园里干活的贝尔老先生。开始之前，她感到很焦虑。

「你的花园怎么都死了？」她问。

这个问题很粗鲁。贝尔先生什么也没说。沉默很尴尬，米娅的脸红了。对她来说，这是很难堪的一分钟。

但贝尔先生只是笑了笑。「我把植物都拔掉了，」他说，「我很好奇接下来会长出什么。」

米娅写了一条简短的笔记就回家了。她把那张笔记夹在书里。

vocabulary.story_sentence: The silence was awkward, and Mia's face turned red.

vocabulary.grammar_note: 形容“事情让人难堪”；自己感到难堪要用 embarrassed。

vocabulary.story_sentence: Before she started, she felt anxious.

vocabulary.story_sentence: I am curious about what will come up next.

vocabulary.story_sentence: Mia wrote a brief note and went home.

title: Under Pressure
story_text:
On Friday, Mia was under pressure. The newspaper had to come out on Monday, and she had no story.

Her teacher, Miss Lin, pressed her every day. "Four lines about a garden is not a story," she said.

The stress made Mia tired. She could not sleep well. The office was small, and the tension in it was easy to feel.

The job was tough, but Mia knew what she wanted. She wanted to find out why Mr. Bell had pulled out all his plants.

On Sunday evening, she opened her book and read her note again. The pressure was still there, but she was ready to write.
translation_zh:
到了周五，米娅感到压力很大。校报周一就要出，她却还没有故事可写。

她的老师林老师每天都催她。「关于花园的四行字不算故事，」她说。

这种压力让米娅很累，睡不好觉。办公室很小，里面的紧张关系很容易感觉到。

这项工作很艰难，但米娅清楚自己想要什么。她想弄清楚贝尔先生为什么把植物都拔了。

周日傍晚，她打开书，又读了一遍笔记。压力还在，但她已经准备好动笔了。

title: The Poisonous Berry
story_text:
On Monday morning, Mia went back to the school garden. Mr. Bell's dog, Rusty, was lying on the grass and could not stand up.

"He ate the red berries," a student said.

A doctor came. She held up a berry. "This plant is poisonous," she said slowly. "Two more berries could be fatal for a dog like Rusty."

Mia felt cold. There was poison in the school garden, and students played there every day.

"Where did it come from?" she asked.

"The previous owner liked strange plants," Mr. Bell said. "The former gardener grew them for colour, not for food."

Rusty was precious to him. Mia wrote down every word.
translation_zh:
周一早上，米娅回到学校花园。贝尔先生的狗拉斯蒂躺在草地上，站不起来。

「他吃了那些红浆果，」一个学生说。

医生来了。她拿起一颗浆果，慢慢地说：「这种植物有毒。再多两颗，对拉斯蒂这样的狗来说就可能是致命的。」

米娅感到一阵发冷。学校花园里有毒药，而学生们每天都在那里玩。

「它是从哪来的？」她问。

「上一任主人喜欢奇怪的植物，」贝尔先生说，「以前那位园丁种它们是为了颜色，不是为了吃。」

拉斯蒂对他来说是珍宝。米娅把每个字都记了下来。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 引起中毒的；有毒的；分泌毒素的
vocabulary.story_sentence: This plant is poisonous.

vocabulary.grammar_note: 指造成死亡的；a fatal mistake 指“致命的错误”。
vocabulary.story_sentence: Two more berries could be fatal for a dog like Rusty.

vocabulary.grammar_note: 指珍贵、宝贵；be precious to somebody 表示“对某人来说很珍贵”。
vocabulary.story_sentence: Rusty was precious to him.

vocabulary.story_sentence: The previous owner liked strange plants.

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 以前的；(两者中) 前者的
vocabulary.story_sentence: The former gardener grew them for colour, not for food.

title: Alarm, Then Relief
story_text:
The news went through the school fast. The school sent home a short, alarming letter. Every family talked about the poisonous plant.

The alarm was real. One man said he would pull out every plant.

On Wednesday, the test results came back. Only one plant was poisonous. The other plants were safe.

The relief was easy to see. Students laughed and ran to the garden.

But Mia wanted to determine how the plant had come. She read old garden books for two days. At last she found the answer: a seed list from twelve years ago.

She was determined to write it down. She still had faith in small facts.
translation_zh:
消息很快传遍了学校。学校给每个家庭发了一封简短的、令人惊恐的信。大家都在谈论那株有毒的植物。

恐慌是真实的。有人说要把花园里的植物全部拔光。

周三，检测结果出来了。只有一株植物有毒，其他的都是安全的。

宽慰显而易见。学生们笑着跑向花园。

但米娅想查明这株植物是怎么来的。她花了两天读花园的旧书。最后她找到了答案：一份十二年前的种子清单。

她决心把它写下来。她依然信任小事实。
image_prompt: Warm editorial illustration for a 4:3 card: a school garden in the morning with students reading a notice on the wall, one plant marked with a small wooden sign, soft hopeful light, muted warm palette, no text, no watermark.

vocabulary.grammar_note: 名词指警报、恐慌；动词指“使惊恐”。
vocabulary.story_sentence: The alarm was real.

vocabulary.grammar_note: 形容事物“让人惊恐”；人感到害怕要用 alarmed。
vocabulary.story_sentence: The school sent home a short, alarming letter.

vocabulary.grammar_note: 不可数名词；常用 to my relief（让我宽慰的是）。
vocabulary.meaning_zh: (焦虑、痛苦的) 减轻或消除；宽慰、轻松
vocabulary.story_sentence: The relief was easy to see.

vocabulary.grammar_note: 表示“查明、确定、决定”，后接名词或从句。
vocabulary.story_sentence: But Mia wanted to determine how the plant had come.

vocabulary.grammar_note: be determined to do something 表示“决心做某事”。
vocabulary.story_sentence: She was determined to write it down.

vocabulary.grammar_note: have faith in somebody/something 表示“信任、信赖”。
vocabulary.story_sentence: She still had faith in small facts.

title: Her Own Voice
story_text:
Six weeks later, the students took care of the garden themselves. They made their own rules and chose their own plants. It was an autonomous garden, and every small piece was independent.

Mr. Bell put a sign on the wall: ASK FIRST.

Mia's story came out with her name under the title. Three teachers told her they had read it.

When she talked to people again, she felt confident. Her confidence did not come from their words. It came from two days of reading and asking.

Mr. Bell called her an intelligent writer. She smiled: her first question had been so rude.

Her belief in small, careful work grew stronger.
translation_zh:
六周后，学生们自己打理起了花园。他们自己定规矩，自己选种什么。这是一个自治的花园，每一小块地都是独立的。

贝尔先生在墙上贴了一块牌子：先问再摘。

米娅的报道登了出来，标题下面印着她的名字。有三个老师告诉她，他们读过了。

再一次和别人交谈时，她感到很自信。这份信心并不来自他们的话，而来自那两天她不停地读、不停地问。

贝尔先生称她是个聪明的作者。她笑了：她的第一个问题曾经那么粗鲁。

她对细小而认真的事情的信念，变得更结实了。

title: The Science Fair
story_text:
Leo was not happy. His class had to join the science fair, and the noise from the next table began to annoy him.

The rules were confusing. There were twelve pages, and after page one Leo felt confused. The long sentences only seemed to confuse him more, so he put the paper down. He read the page again, but the words did not help.

Then a girl from Class Two turned on a small machine. Water began to climb up a glass tube by itself.

"That is amazing," Leo said. He was annoyed with himself for saying it, but he could not look away.
translation_zh:
利奥不太高兴。他们班必须参加科学展，而旁边桌子传来的噪音开始让他心烦。

规则很难懂。一共有十二页，看完第一页利奥就糊涂了。那些长句子只让他更糊涂，于是他把纸放下了。他又读了一遍，但那些字还是没帮上忙。

这时，二班的一个女生启动了一台小机器。水自己顺着玻璃管往上爬。

「这太神奇了，」利奥说。他为自己说出这句话而生气，但他没法把目光移开。

title: A Fascinating Machine
story_text:
At lunch, Leo went back to the machine. The girl was still there. Her name was Nina.

"It is only water and salt," she said. "But look."

The water climbed again. Leo was amazed. He did not understand it, but the little machine was fascinating to him.

Nina showed him a magnet. It could attract paper clips through a page. Leo was attracted to the quiet way she worked, and soon he was absorbed in the little machine too.

That evening he read about salt water for two hours. His mother laughed. "You are a science addict now," she said.
translation_zh:
午饭时，利奥又回到那台机器旁。那个女生还在。她叫妮娜。

「这只是水和盐，」她说，「但你看看。」

水又爬上去了。利奥很惊奇。他并不明白，但这台小机器对他来说很迷人。

妮娜给他看了一块磁铁。它能隔着纸把回形针吸过来。利奥被她安静做事的样子吸引住了，很快他也沉浸在那台小机器里。

那天晚上，他读了两个小时关于盐水的书。妈妈笑了。「你现在是个科学迷了，」她说。

title: The Dark Science Room
story_text:
Two weeks later, Leo and Nina had a real experiment. They had to test their machine in the old science room at the back of the school.

The entrance was small, and the exit door was locked. Only one window gave light.

Halfway through the test, the machine made a loud noise and the room went dark. Leo was frightened. His hands were shaking.

"Do not move," Nina said quietly. She found the switch and the light came back.

Leo laughed at himself, but Nina did not. "You are addicted," she said.

Leo did not say no. He was addicted to the feeling of finding an answer.
translation_zh:
两周后，利奥和妮娜有了一个真正的实验。他们要在学校后面那间旧科学室里测试他们的机器。

入口很小，出口的门是锁着的。只有一扇窗透进光来。

测试到一半，机器发出很大的响声，房间一下黑了。利奥吓坏了，双手在发抖。

「别动，」妮娜轻声说。她找到了开关，灯又亮了。

利奥笑自己，但妮娜没有笑。「你上瘾了，」她说。

利奥没有否认。他沉醉于找到答案的那种感觉。

title: One Page of Notes
story_text:
On Friday, the teacher asked them to write about their work. Leo found this harder than the machine.

"Start with the parts," Nina said.

So Leo wrote: a bottle, salt, a paper tube, and a small lamp. Salt was the most important addition. In addition, they needed warm water. They used a magnet as well as a battery to move the water faster.

Moreover, the tube had to be clean. Salt water climbs up the paper, and thus the colour rises with it. The paper must never be wet, therefore they waited ten minutes before they started.

It was only one page. But the teacher read it twice.
translation_zh:
周五，老师让他们写一写自己的作品。利奥觉得这比机器还难。

「从零件写起，」妮娜说。

于是利奥写道：一个瓶子、盐、一个纸筒和一盏小灯。盐是最重要的添加物。除此之外，他们还需要温水。他们用一块磁铁以及一块电池，让水移动得更快。

而且，纸筒必须干净。盐水顺着纸往上爬，因此颜色也跟着上升。纸绝不能湿，所以他们在开始前等了十分钟。

这只有一页。但老师读了两遍。

title: The Day of the Fair
story_text:
On the day of the fair, Leo stood behind their table and waited.

"What on earth will they ask us?" he said.

"Anything," Nina said.

The first question was about salt. Leo took a breath and explained it. He did not need any external help, and this time his inner voice was calm.

At last three teachers came to their table. They asked questions and wrote for a long time.

"We may not win," Nina said.

"After all, we are only two students," Leo said. "But we must keep our notes, otherwise we will forget how we did it."

Nina smiled. "Last month you did not like science," she said.
translation_zh:
科学展那天，利奥站在他们的桌子后面等着。

「他们究竟会问我们什么？」他说。

「什么都有可能，」妮娜说。

第一个问题是关于盐的。利奥吸了口气，把它解释了一遍。他不需要任何外来的帮助，这一次他内心的声音很平静。

三位老师终于来到他们的桌前。他们问了几个问题，写了很久。

「我们可能赢不了，」妮娜说。

「毕竟我们只是两个学生，」利奥说，「但我们必须留下笔记，否则我们会忘记自己是怎么做的。」

妮娜笑了。「上个月你还不喜欢科学呢，」她说。

title: The New Flat
story_text:
Last summer, Leo's family moved to a new apartment near his school. His father had to rent it for a year.

The flat was small but clean. It had two rooms, a kitchen and a bathroom. Apart from the noise from the street, Leo liked it.

His mother made all the arrangements. She put a desk by the window for him.

On the first night, Leo heard a strange movement in the wall. He sat up and listened. Then he heard a small sound again, and he smiled. It was only the old pipes.

The desk looked like a good place to study.
translation_zh:
去年夏天，利奥一家搬进了学校附近的一间新公寓。爸爸得把它租一年。

这套单元房不大，但很干净。有两间房、一个厨房和一间浴室。除了街上的噪音，利奥挺喜欢这里的。

所有安排都是妈妈做的。她把一张书桌放在窗边，给他用。

第一天晚上，利奥听见墙里有一种奇怪的动静。他坐起来听。接着又听见一声轻响，他笑了。那只是旧水管在响。

那张书桌看起来是个学习的好地方。

title: When Things Fall Apart
story_text:
One month later, the old flat began to fall apart. A pipe broke, and water ran down the wall.

Leo's father called the building department. A man came and looked at the wall. He said the pipes were too old and would come apart in the winter.

"We need permission to fix them," the man said. "The owner must permit the work."

That evening the family talked about it. Leo's mother made a comment that everyone laughed at: "At least the water is free."

Leo did not laugh. He put a glass under the water and went to bed.
translation_zh:
一个月后，这套旧单元房开始散架了。一根水管破了，水顺着墙流下来。

利奥的爸爸给楼房管理部打了电话。一个人来看墙。他说管子太旧了，冬天会裂开。

「我们需要许可才能修，」那个人说，「业主必须允许这项维修。」

那天晚上，一家人讨论这件事。利奥的妈妈说了一句让大家都笑了的评论：「至少水是免费的。」

利奥没笑。他拿了个杯子放在漏水下面，就去睡了。

title: Sixty Yuan
story_text:
Fixing the pipes cost a lot of money, so Leo wanted to earn some himself.

He started with small jobs at home. Every morning he cleaned the living room and washed the cups, and his mother paid him two yuan. Altogether, he made sixty yuan in the first month.

His friend Ben laughed. "You cannot earn a living with that," he said.

"I bet I can," Leo said. "In one year I will save enough for a new desk. Let us make a bet."

"Fine," Ben said. "But it is a silly bet."

Leo smiled. He had never worked for anything before.
translation_zh:
修管道花了很多钱，所以利奥想自己挣一点。

他从家里的小活干起。每天早上他打扫起居室、洗杯子，妈妈给他两块钱。总共，他第一个月挣了六十块。

他的朋友本笑了。「靠这个你可没法谋生，」他说。

「我敢说我可以，」利奥说，「一年之内我能攒够钱买一张新书桌。我们打个赌吧。」

「行，」本说，「不过这赌打得真傻。」

利奥笑了。他以前从没为任何东西努力过。

title: A Bad First Day
story_text:
In September, Leo started senior high school. The building was big, and he felt small.

On the first day, a senior student showed him around. Her name was Chen. She talked fast and knew every room.

Leo wanted to impress her. He asked good questions, but somehow asked them at the wrong time. Once he spoke while she was drinking water, and she laughed.

"Do not worry," she said. "I made a bad impression on my first day too."

"Did you?" Leo asked.

"No," she said. "But now you feel better."

But Leo did make an impression. A week later, Chen asked him to join the school radio club.
translation_zh:
九月，利奥升入了高中。这栋楼很大，他觉得自己很小。

开学第一天，一位高年级学生带他参观。她叫陈。她说话很快，每一间屋子都认识。

利奥很想给她留下好印象。他问了一些好问题，但不知怎么的，全问错了时候。有一次她正在喝水，他开口说话，她笑了。

「别担心，」她说，「我第一天也留下了坏印象。」

「真的吗？」利奥问。

「假的，」她说，「不过你现在心情好点了。」

但利奥确实留下了印象。一周后，陈邀请他加入学校的广播社。

title: Leave Me Alone
story_text:
The radio club took all of Leo's time. His marks went down, and his mother was worried.

"You must focus on your study," she said.

"I know," Leo said. "But the club is fun."

He tried to concentrate at home, but his little sister ran in and out of his room. He could not focus.

"Leave me alone!" he shouted one evening. His sister cried, and Leo felt bad.

"What if you study at the library?" his mother said. "There is nobody there."

The next day Leo went to the library. He sat down and concentrated on his books. For the first time in weeks, the pages made sense.
translation_zh:
广播社占去了利奥所有的时间。他的成绩下降了，妈妈很担心。

「你必须专注在学习上，」她说。

「我知道，」利奥说，「但社团很好玩。」

他在家想集中注意力，可妹妹总在他房间里跑进跑出。他没法专注。

一天晚上他喊：「别打扰我！」妹妹哭了，利奥也觉得不好受。

「要不去图书馆学习？」妈妈说，「那儿没人。」

第二天利奥去了图书馆。他坐下来，专心看他的书。几个星期以来第一次，这些书页看懂了。

title: Visitors on Campus
story_text:
In May, some students from a junior high school came to visit Leo's campus. They walked around in small groups and asked many questions.

The campus was green and quiet that morning. Leo's class had to give a formal welcome, and Miss Lin told them to take notes during the visit.

"Look forward to their questions," she said. "And do not be afraid of them."

One girl asked Leo why he liked this school. He thought for a moment and then said, "Because everyone looks forward, not back."

The girl wrote it down. Leo felt proud of his answer.
translation_zh:
五月，一所初级中学的学生来参观利奥的校园。他们分成小组到处走，问了很多问题。

那天早上，校园里很绿，很安静。利奥他们班要做一个正式的欢迎，林老师让他们在参观时记笔记。

「要盼望他们提问，」她说，「别怕他们。」

一个女生问利奥为什么喜欢这所学校。他想了一会儿，然后说：「因为这里的人都在向前看，不往后看。」

那个女生把这句话记了下来。利奥为自己的回答感到自豪。

vocabulary.story_sentence: In May, some students from a junior high school came to visit Leo's campus.

vocabulary.grammar_note: 表示“记笔记”，note 常用复数；take notes on something 表示“记某事的笔记”。
vocabulary.story_sentence: Leo's class had to give a formal welcome, and Miss Lin told them to take notes during the visit.

vocabulary.grammar_note: 表示“盼望、期待”，to 是介词，后面接名词或动名词。
vocabulary.story_sentence: "Look forward to their questions," she said.

title: The Plan
story_text:
Leo was in his last year of senior high school. Before he graduates, he wants to do something useful.

His class decided to establish a small company for the campus market. They had to register it online first.

The plan was long. Leo read it twice, then began to revise it. "Our vocabulary is too hard," he said. "Write it in simple words."

They also talked about their position in the market. "Other classes sell food," Nina said. "We need something different."

"Camping things," Leo said. "Tents and pots for the school trip."

Their teacher liked the idea at once.
translation_zh:
利奥在高中最后一年。毕业之前，他想做点有用的事。

他们班决定为校园市集创立一家小公司。得先在网上注册。

计划很长。利奥读了两遍，然后开始修改。「我们的用词太难了，」他说，「用简单的词写。」

他们还讨论了在市场上的位置。「别的班卖吃的，」妮娜说，「我们得做点不一样的。」

「露营用品，」利奥说，「学校旅行用的帐篷和锅。」

老师一听就喜欢这个主意。

title: From the Port
story_text:
Leo's uncle worked at the port. He knew how to import and export goods.

"You can order from a factory," he said. "They will send the goods to the port."

Leo's class needed four tents and ten pots for the school trip. The staff of the shop helped them choose.

"These tents are light," a woman said. "And this pot is big enough for six people."

The goods came in two boxes. Leo carried them to the classroom and put a tent up in the corner. Everyone laughed.

The tent took up half the room. "Now we have a shop," Nina said.
translation_zh:
利奥的叔叔在港口工作。他懂怎么进口和出口货物。

「你可以向工厂订货，」他说，「他们会把货送到港口。」

利奥他们班为学校旅行需要四顶帐篷和十个锅。商店的员工帮他们挑选。

「这些帐篷很轻，」一位女士说，「这个锅够六个人用。」

货装在两个箱子里。利奥把它们搬到教室，在角落支起一顶帐篷。大家都笑了。

帐篷占了半个教室。「现在我们有店了，」妮娜说。

title: Market Day
story_text:
On market day, the basketball court was full of tables. Leo's company had a corner near the gate.

Nina took photos with a flash, and Leo put the pictures on the wall. "We need to promote the tents," she said.

A boy came to look. He had no friends with him, so Leo kept him company and told him about the school trip.

By noon they had sold three tents. Two teachers stopped to ask about the pots. The court was noisy and hot.

The profit was small, but it was real.

"People like a good story," Nina said. "That is why they buy."
translation_zh:
市集那天，篮球场上摆满了桌子。利奥他们公司占了靠门的一个角落。

妮娜开着闪光灯拍照，利奥把照片贴在墙上。「我们得推销帐篷，」她说。

一个男生过来看。他没有朋友陪着，利奥就陪着他，给他讲学校旅行的事。

到中午他们卖出了三顶帐篷。两个老师停下来问锅的事。球场又吵又热。

利润不多，但是真的。

「人们喜欢好故事，」妮娜说，「所以他们才买。」

vocabulary.story_sentence: Nina took photos with a flash, and Leo put the pictures on the wall.

vocabulary.story_sentence: He had no friends with him, so Leo kept him company and told him about the school trip.

vocabulary.grammar_note: 指“利润、利益”，make a profit 表示“盈利”，与 loss（亏损）相对。
vocabulary.story_sentence: The profit was small, but it was real.

title: A Good End
story_text:
After the market, the class counted the money. "We can recover half of what we spent," Nina said.

The teacher was happy. In return, she let them keep the tents for the school trip.

"Your plan was effective," she said. "Indeed, it worked better than mine."

The next week they met again to talk about the company. They wanted to improve it and run a second operation in autumn.

"When we graduate," Leo said, "we should leave the plan for the next class."

Nina nodded. "Then it will not end with us."

The classroom was quiet, and Leo felt calm.
translation_zh:
市集结束后，班里数了数钱。「我们能收回一半花掉的钱，」妮娜说。

老师很高兴。作为回报，她让他们把帐篷留着学校旅行用。

「你们的计划很有效，」她说，「确实，比我那个管用。」

下一周他们又聚在一起谈公司的事。他们想改进它，秋天再经营一轮。

「等我们毕业，」利奥说，「应该把计划留给下一届。」

妮娜点点头。「那就不会到我们这里就结束了。」

教室很安静，利奥心里很平静。
